notes.title: Alpha 241126: New contract system, visitor system and more!
notes.content:
[h3]New Features and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Data Models:[/b]
    - Customers: Tracks happiness, datacenter location preferences, SLA, average delivery time, and event logs.
    - Orders: Includes company reputation, recurrence types, assigned staff, and event logs.
    - Websites: Maintains hourly logs of visits and customer conversions.
    - Packages: Features setup fees, stock quantities, delivery times, discounts for recurring orders, and options for unmetered/metered traffic and CIDR selection.
[*][b]Dataset Updates:[/b]
    - Added 5,000 customers from the USA, UK, Canada, and Australia, with latitude/longitude for latency simulation.
[*][b]Gameplay Enhancements:[/b]
    - Time scale adjusted from 72 minutes to 24 minutes per in-game day.
    - Initial in-game date set to January 1, 2024.
    - Unity engine upgraded to version 6.
    - Improved form formatting and validation system.
    - Redesigned UI for order delivery with countdown, details, and checklist.
[*][b]Simulation Mechanics:[/b]
    - New algorithm to simulate visitor traffic and customer conversions using company reputation, marketing quality, and website performance.
[*][b]Order and Contract System:[/b]
    - Finished contract generator with recurring billing and cancellation handling.
    - Reworked order listing to prioritize expiration timers.
    - Enhanced order delivery system with countdown timers and delivery details.
[*][b]Rack Placement Improvements:[/b]
    - Removed gaps between racks.
    - Added automatic alignment when racks are placed near walls.
[*][b]Server Management:[/b]
    - Domains registered by players are now accessible via in-game browser if DNS zones and server software are configured.
    - Additional error types when accessing misconfigured domains.
    - Fixed bugs related to server software persistence on save reload.
[*][b]Package Management Updates:[/b]
    - Redesigned package creation and editing forms with new fields.
    - Fixed issues with unlimited stock configuration.
[*][b]UI and Accessibility:[/b]
    - Improved text contrast in website publishing checklists.
    - Asynchronous UI layout rebuilding for better performance.
    - Notifications added for successful saves on DNS and company data pages.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed incorrect network cable removal blocking in the network system.
[*]Corrected issues with misplaced cable connectors during installation animations.
[*]Addressed bugs in website publishing logic when modifying checklist items before publishing.
[*]Fixed save-related errors causing duplicated inventory creation.
[*]Fixed errors in hostname command visibility within FlockCMD help.
[*]Resolved bugs in package and order display logic.
[/list]

[h3]Quality of Life Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*]Removed serial numbers displayed on device fronts; added them to the focus text instead.
[*]Removed redundant mission entries for order delivery, unifying it in ControlHost.whs.
[/list]

Alpha access via Ko-Fi: https://ko-fi.com/WebHostSimulator

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/JuyyPbZ

notes.title: Devlog, Alpha access and more
notes.content:
This is the first devlog I'm writing and maybe I should write more often, but today I want to talk about the news for those who aren't on our Discord yet and also thank you that we're more than 125% of the target reached after 50 days of launching our Ko-Fi for alpha access, it's very motivating to have the community support and to be interested in the game!

[h2]How is the development going?[/h2]
Currently, development is focused on creating core game mechanics, complete lifecycle of a datacenter and performance optimizations.

At the moment the game has the following objects: Rack, rail, ethernet cable with real-time physics, server, switch, terminal with operating system based on command line, uplink cable tray and ladder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37799684/b5578df8fad086cdc6e777aafcd643c38f5cc70b.jpg[/img]

In the next alpha update we will have “crash cart”, HDD, functional equipment HDD bays, functional terminal commands and several fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37799684/3eed66cfee89725f0f1f9bb83f5c24c81949b9aa.png[/img]

[h2]How do I participate in alpha access?[/h2]
To participate in alpha access, go to http://ko-fi.com/WebHostSimulator, donate 15 euros or more and you will have access to exclusive rooms on Discord and rewards depending on the package you choose.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37799684/31c51e26a75543dc145309c2a12f711e10d4217f.png[/img]

[h2]When will early access on Steam be released?[/h2]
We intend to launch Early Access in 2022 and Ko-Fi donors of the Silver and Gold package will also receive the early access key.

[h2]What will be in the first version of Early Access?[/h2]
The objective of the first version is that all the basic functionalities are implemented, with some environments such as datacenter, apartment and the sandbox mode ready.

Ko-Fi: https://ko-fi.com/WebHostSimulator
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/JuyyPbZ
